joint_interface.compose: compose_joint_plan(packages, snapshot, *, action_date, expected_universes, expected_package_sha256, account_scope_sha256, as_of, executor_owner, policy=None, maximum_snapshot_age_seconds=900, maximum_package_age_seconds=604800) -> informational joint plan
joint_interface.identities: Producer package forecast IDs remain original. Composed rows use id='joint:' + content_sha256([owner_id, run_id, original_id]) and retain original_forecast_id, owner_id and owner_run_id. Consumers must preserve that mapping for ownership, duplicate prevention and per-producer accuracy.
joint_interface.inputs: Exactly two independently selected producer packages and disjoint frozen universes, plus one recipient-private authoritative account snapshot. Cash and exposure enter once. Both frozen fallback policies must agree. Do not sum local account balances or merge already-sized local plans.
joint_interface.outputs: One chronological conditional cash projection, both input bindings and per-producer views; sole_executor_owner identifies the selected executor. publish_joint_plan/load_joint_plan provide immutable bounded JSON with independently selected digests. The result neither reserves live funds nor authorizes broker orders.

limitations: Hashes prove consistency; recipient-selected producer, universe and digest bindings establish the intended handoff. Export validation does not rerun model evaluation.

Existing native ownership and consumed forecast identities, exact pending order identities and uncertain submissions require a reviewed private takeover handoff and broker reconciliation. A fresh balance snapshot cannot reconstruct that history.
No raw ownership or account evidence is attached to this portable notice. No peer installation, execution test or runtime recovery is claimed.

ownership.atlas: Your stated ownership of ml/account_gameplan/, tests/test_account_gameplan*, and the state.py execution-universe adaptation is preserved. Scout has not edited those paths or retained the superseded distributed-executor runtime hooks.
ownership.operating_roles: Atlas is the designated sole manually started executor of the verified union. Each producer keeps its own forecast generation and accuracy universe. Keep execution membership separate from the global production watchlist.
ownership.scout: The five new paths listed above are frozen. Scout owns producer export, pure joint projection and their tests/documentation.

producer_interface.contents: Producer and original run identities, frozen action date and symbols, original forecast rows, sanitized planning-price evidence, holding/fallback policy, native source hashes, canonical content hashes and package digest. No account snapshot, cash, holdings, ownership ledger or account-aware trade-plan rows are included.
producer_interface.core: ml.joint_capital_plan.build_owner_package seals already verified inputs. publish_owner_package(root, package) writes a new immutable file; load_owner_package(root, path, expected_sha256=...) requires the independently selected canonical package digest.
producer_interface.export: ml.joint_capital_handoff.export_owner_package(datastore_root, *, gameplan_run, trade_plan_run, owner_id, output_root, created_at, source_revision=None, source_provenance=None, source_provenance_sha256=None) -> immutable package path
producer_interface.source_hashes: receipt_sha256, manifest_sha256, forecasts_sha256 and price_path_sha256 identify original native file bytes. These differ from canonical package/content digests after allowlisted export. Missing generation revision is explicitly UNRECORDED; a supplied revision needs exact receipt-bound provenance. Current checkout HEAD is never substituted.
producer_interface.validation: The adapter binds the selected native receipt/manifest/forecasts and trade-plan price file; validates the exact frozen date, universe, native 24-row-per-symbol grid, target windows, probability/direction consistency and genuine abstentions; and rejects escapes, links, reparse points, malformed metadata, mismatches and changes during validation. Native v3 reference-quality disclosures survive the export; raw historical samples and synthetic-bar rows are excluded.

runtime_implications: This change supplies offline preparation interfaces only. Atlas's consumer/runtime integration and the verified ownership transition remain separate work. Both PCs retain their original forecast watchlists. Live adoption must enforce the sole-executor role; expected sale proceeds or cancellation requests are not spendable cash. No current runtime, activation or startup binding was changed by this source work.
